## File: facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/depth_decoder.py

Prompts

```
['create a DepthDecoder with encoder channel counts and optional output scales for monocular depth estimation', 'run the DepthDecoder forward pass with a list of encoder feature tensors to get multi-scale depth outputs', 'build a DepthDecoder with skip connections enabled to concatenate encoder features during upsampling', 'review the DepthDecoder upsampling architecture with ConvBlock layers and bilinear upsampling at five pyramid levels', 'test the DepthDecoder forward pass with custom scales to produce depth predictions at selected pyramid levels', 'build a PoseDecoder network module that decodes camera pose from encoded feature maps', 'create a PoseDecoder with custom num_frames_to_predict_for to predict poses for a specific number of frames', 'run the PoseDecoder forward pass on input features to get axisangle rotation and translation vectors', 'review the PoseDecoder convolutional layers that squeeze features and predict 6-DOF pose per frame', 'test the PoseDecoder forward method to verify it returns axisangle and translation tensors', 'build a ResnetEncoderMatching model with 50 layers and 96 depth bins for monocular depth estimation', 'create a cost volume by matching features between current and lookup frames using L1 difference', 'compute linear or inverse depth bins for hypothesised depths used in the cost volume', 'extract multi-scale feature maps from an input image using the first two ResNet blocks', 'build a ResNet model that accepts multiple stacked input images with pretrained ImageNet weights']
```

```

```

name: facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/dept.create_depth_decoder: create a DepthDecoder with encoder channel counts and optional output scales for monocular depth estimation
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/dept.run_depth_decoder_forward: run the DepthDecoder forward pass with a list of encoder feature tensors to get multi-scale depth outputs
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/dept.build_depth_decoder_with_skips: build a DepthDecoder with skip connections enabled to concatenate encoder features during upsampling
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/dept.review_depth_decoder_architecture: review the DepthDecoder upsampling architecture with ConvBlock layers and bilinear upsampling at five pyramid levels

facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/pose.build_pose_decoder: build a PoseDecoder network module that decodes camera pose from encoded feature maps
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/pose.create_pose_decoder_with_custom_frames: create a PoseDecoder with custom num_frames_to_predict_for to predict poses for a specific number of frames
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/pose.run_pose_decoder_forward: run the PoseDecoder forward pass on input features to get axisangle rotation and translation vectors
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/pose.review_pose_decoder_convs: review the PoseDecoder convolutional layers that squeeze features and predict 6-DOF pose per frame
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/pose.test_pose_decoder_output: test the PoseDecoder forward method to verify it returns axisangle and translation tensors

facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/resn.build_resnet_encoder_matching: build a ResnetEncoderMatching model with 50 layers and 96 depth bins for monocular depth estimation
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/resn.create_cost_volume: create a cost volume by matching features between current and lookup frames using L1 difference
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/resn.compute_depth_bins: compute linear or inverse depth bins for hypothesised depths used in the cost volume
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/resn.extract_resnet_features: extract multi-scale feature maps from an input image using the first two ResNet blocks
facebookresearch_distdepth/networks/resn.build_multiimage_resnet: build a ResNet model that accepts multiple stacked input images with pretrained ImageNet weights
